The issuer demonstrates strong profitability with an 11% operating margin and robust interest coverage estimated at approximately 8.36x, supporting investment-grade quality. However, high leverage is evident with a debt-to-equity ratio of 3.50 and an equity ratio of 22.2%, compounded by a weak current ratio of 1.22 indicating liquidity concerns. These factors align with a BBB rating, reflecting adequate capacity to meet financial commitments but heightened susceptibility to adverse conditions.

DECISION: BBB
